ops.body: - [owner] From the UI review (Nov 19, medium, U1): a picture standing on the map looks like the thing to tap (the card visibly shrinks onto it, and it is drawn as the stack's entries are), but a tap on it only holds the replay; the stack at the edge is the one way to the photos, found on the second look. Seconds later the card says "Tap a pin to open it" for the same places. The reviewer's fix, not built because it is a new control the spec did not decide: a tap on a standing picture opens the viewer at that moment (a 44 pt target around the 36 px tile, the replay held as the stack holds it). Precedent: Day One's map, "Tap on the pins to view the entries"

- [owner] From the UI review (Nov 19, medium at 320 by 568 only, U2): when the card arrives with a gap to ask about, "Keep the likely way?" runs from the top to about y 183 and the card's sheet starts at about y 197, so the walk (at y 95 to 200 on the last view) is wholly under the question and "Tap a pin to open it" points at nothing. At 390 it stays in view. The question's card is older than this slice; the lower map (the entry above on 116 px) moved the walk under it. The reviewer's fixes: ask after the card has settled, or inside the sheet, on a screen this short

- [loop] From the UI review and the cold find (Nov 19, low): the stack's target is 44 wide, under Android's 48 dp, and at its bound stands 8 px under Next in one column with Skip (U3: a hit slop, and start it 12 under Next); on a 320 px phone a stack of eight or more would run 16 to 25 px over a whisper or the last view's name, not pictured (U4: end their room short of the stack); a grid of three leaves a pale empty cell and its strip says "Photo" (U5, opinion: let the last row's picture span the row, say "Photos"); a whisper is 13 px italic on a halo, not the solid ground the house rule asks for text over a picture (U6: the glass ground the last view's name has, clear of its pin). The cold find placed every task; it first read the stack's single entry as a second pin on the map, the video's tile in the corner as a record button, and the last view's date (no year) as today's

| Replay ceremony (the replay reworked to run smoothly and look as the owner's mock-up: each frame drawn outside the screens' rendering, the walked line revealed and never re-sent; zoom 15, a camera that holds and re-frames or rises on a long stretch, a photo's pin under its card; a break crossed by a dotted hop with no dim; the path diving in from the first beat's view and closing on the card's, with the date and the passed places named; a card shrinking onto its place where its picture stands, a side stack that grows first in first out, a scrim and a drift, a moment's videos in turn; captions RC38-RC44 wait for the first phone build; RC1-RC48, decision 0206) | built; web only | tests first, then the code, 2026-11-19 (41 of 41); the owner looked twice at the preview address on an iPhone | `specs/replay-ceremony/spec.md` | no (steward on the plan, cold find and UI review only) |
